kit.title: Ember vs Nextmug vs OHOM Ui: which heated mug to give
kit.hook: Picture this: three heated mugs in your cart, and you can only give one.

scenes.narration: Picture this: three heated mugs in your cart, and one person to give to. You have read the reviews twice. Still three mugs.
scenes.visual: b-roll:three mugs side by side, steam rising

scenes.narration: Pick by where they drink, not by the brand.
Ember Mug 2 for the exact-temperature person. Set 120 to 145 degrees in its app.
It holds heat up to an hour and a half off its coaster. The longest of the three.
scenes.visual: product:Ember Mug 2 lifted off its coaster

scenes.narration: Nextmug for the app-hater. Fourteen ounces, one button, three heat settings.
OHOM Ui for the desk worker. No battery, no app, and the Artist mug is dishwasher safe.
scenes.visual: product:OHOM Ui mug on its pad

scenes.narration: The catch: it only warms on its pad. Walk to a meeting and it is just a mug.
scenes.visual: b-roll:someone carrying a mug away from a desk as it stops steaming

scenes.narration: Two mugs go back in the cart. One goes in the box. Full side-by-side table at the link.
